translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Luk Tikak

content: Seytan Jiysis Nup Yesek Aŋgak

Pen Jiysis Joden ñiŋg mindiy andkind owakniŋ, Gor Kawnan ak nup bak ay, dand miñmon nep namb okok amek, nuk tap ñimbiy mer; yikop nep mindek ñin omiŋal jiwak. Pen nuk kun okok giraŋgakniŋ, Seytan minim yip ak niŋaŋ aŋgiy, ap nup aŋgak,
“Nand Gor Ñinuk mindiy ker, kamb biy aŋgey biret rek ayek ñiŋan aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Jiysis nup pen aŋgak, “Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak, ‘Biynimb gok biret nep ñimbiy ma mindeniŋgambay aŋgyak.’”
Aŋgek, Seytan Jiysis nup dand miñmon yirik paryomb yimb bap amiy, miñmon okok maŋgiysek yimb yomiy

aŋgak, “Miñmon teprep guniy niŋan! Biyomb keykey kond mindpay. Yand miñmon kun gok maŋgiysek kond mindpiyn rek, bi bap nup aŋgniŋg aŋgniŋgayn. Kun ak nand koŋgim yimiy yip aŋgniŋeniŋgamban, miñmon kun guniy maŋgiysek nip aŋgen, yimb yomb mindakniŋ kond mindeniŋgamban aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Jiysis pen aŋgak, “Nip ma nep aŋgniŋniŋgayn! Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak, ‘Biyomb chin Gor nup nep aŋgniŋiy, woŋg nup anep giñinimimb aŋgyak’ aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, Seytan Jiysis nup poŋind Jerusalem amiy, dand Gor aŋgniŋep korip yiy akyoŋ giyak ar ak amiy aŋgak, “Nand Gor Ñinuk mindpiyn aŋgiy, pindeŋg man biyaŋ ayan!
Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak, ‘Gor enjol nuk gok aŋgek nip kond mindeniŋgambay.’
Minim bap pen tikiy aŋgyak, ‘Apyap pikniŋg gey, nip dand araney, kamb tomb nip ak ma pikniŋgamb aŋgyak’ aŋgak.”
Seytan kun aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Biyomb Gor windin yirik ar ak, ñiñloŋ ay kun ak rek ma giniŋgayn. Baybol buk ak, ‘Nup ñiñloŋ ma ayep aŋgiy tikyak’ aŋgak.”
Seytan Jiysis nup minim tom gi mer niŋiy, kiriŋg amiy, gos nuk okok nep, ‘Minek gunap, nup tip ak tom ginim aŋgiy’ kasek ma andkind owak.
Jiysis Miñmon Galiyliy Kiñiŋ Giy Minim Aŋgñak
Pen Gor Kawnan ak Jiysis nup kond mindakniŋ, andkind ap miñmon Galiyliy mindiy, key yimb gek niŋiy, minim nup ak yiŋg dand, miñmon Galiyliy namb okok maŋgiysek amniyak.
Nuk Jiwda nan-gep korip okok amiy, minim aŋgrep gek, nup bi tep yimb aŋgiy, miñmiñ yimb giyak.
Nasaret Biynimb Jiysis Nup Ma Diyak

Pen Jiysis nuk miñmon Galiyliy namb okok giraŋg diy, miñmon sikoy mindiy yomb gak Nasaret am mindek. Jiwda lotiw ñin ak apek, per giyiŋgip rek, nan-gep korip ak amiy, tikjakiy Baybol buk ak riytiym giniŋg gek,
nup bi Gor minim aŋgep Asaya tikak buk band ak dap ñey, di wisikiy, minim aŋgniŋg gak day ak niŋiy, kuyip riyt giy aŋgak:

content.text: “Biyomb ak, woŋg nuk gunap yip gaŋ aŋgiy, Kawnan nuk ak yokek yand yip mindip. Kun ak biynimb simbgeprek gok aŋgrep gen niŋniŋgambay. Biynimb kalambis rek mindpay gok wisik yoken amniŋgambay. Biynimb windin koy rek mindpay gok gen niŋniŋgambay. Biynimb kosyam mindpay gok direp giniŋgayn.
Pen Gor biynimb diniŋgamb ñin tep ak, miñiy owip aŋgiy, biynimb gok kuyip aŋgñiniŋgayn aŋgak.”

content: Jiysis minim kun ak riyt gi day jiwiy, buk band ak kom kom giy, bi buk kond mindyiŋgip anup tip ak ñiy bisgek, biynimb mindeyak gok maŋgiysek windin ak jiwiy nup nep niŋeyak, kuyip aŋgak,
“Asaya Biyomb aŋgek, per kond mindpim kun ak miñiy miseŋ niŋsipim aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, minim tep yimb nuk aŋgak ak niŋiy, yimb nup ak dand araniyak. Pen gos bap niŋiy aŋgyak, “Bi kun biy Josep ñinuk rek?”

Kun aŋgey, Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Pen yand niŋbiyn! Yip aŋgniŋgambim, ‘Nand Kiyŋ yomb key yimb per kond mindpun ak, miñmon Kapaniyam mindiy, tap mageprek gey, yind achimal apek niŋbun rek ak, miñmon nak biy kunep gey niŋjun aŋgniŋgambim.’

Pen nimbip niŋind aspiyn. Bi Gor minim aŋgep gok, miñmon bapik okok taŋgiy, minim tep ak aŋgey, niŋind apay aŋgiy dipay. Pen miñmon kiyk ak key ap aŋgey, bi chin gok key aspay aŋgiy minim kuyip ak ma dipay.
“Pen niŋim! Bi Gor minim aŋgep Yilayja mindek ñin ak, simiy omiŋal nokom takin onep kaŋgol ak, miñmon ma yimb pikiy, tap ma jakiy, yiwan yomb sikerek yimb ak gak.

Yisrel biyn yandiw yiwan gak gok, kuŋaynep mindeyak ak pen; Gor Yilayja nup yokek, am miñmon yomb Saydon miñmon sikoy Sareypar amiy, tap mageprek ak gek, biyn yandiw bap keñmaŋgiy nuk kuŋaynep mindek.

Pen ar kun ak rek, kisen, bi Gor minim aŋgep Yilayja mindek ñin ak, Yisrel biynimb soy ayndik ayak gok, kuŋay yimb mindeyak ak pen; kuyip gunap gek suŋ ma ayak; bi Neman miñmon paryomb Siyriya nimb ak nep gek suŋ ayak aŋgak.”
Jiysis kun aŋgek, biynimb lotiw korip mindeyak gok niŋey miluk timey yimb yapek,
nup yuk dam minduŋ okok yokon kumaŋ aŋgiy, yukey amnakniŋ, biynimb kuŋay mindeyak namb okok amiy kapkap amnak.
Jiysis Kichekiy Aŋg Mis Yokak
Nuk miñmon sikoy Kapaniyam Galiyliy propens ak am mindiy, Jiwda lotiw ñin ak apek, tikjakiy kuyip minim aŋgñak.
Gor minim ak yiñrimey giy, yipund giy yimb nep aŋgek, wal yimb aŋgyak.
Pen nan-gep korip namb kun ak, bi kichekiy ambaŋ ayak bap mindek. Nuk suk yomb aŋgiy aŋgak,
“Bi Jiysis Nasaret nimb! Yerginiŋg opan? Chinup timey giniŋg opan rek ayip. Yand nip niŋbiyn; Gor bi suŋ-tep nuk anep opan aŋgak.”

Pen Jiysis kichekiy ambaŋ ay mindek kun anup aŋgak, “Minim ma aŋgiy, bi ak kirgiy mis amnoŋ.” Aŋgek, mis amyiŋg, bi nonim yipund giy anup, biynimb mindeyak namb siŋak diyokiy amnak ak pen, nup tapin ma pikak.
Kun gek, biynimb niŋmindeyak gok, kiyk nep aŋgniŋ aŋgniŋ giy aŋgyak, “Bi kalrimey kun biy, minim kun ak akay nimb dand apiy aŋgek, kichekiy gok mis ambay aŋgyak.”
Pen Jiysis gak minim kun ak, yiŋg dand miñmon kun okok maŋgiysek amniyak.
Jiysis Biynimb Gek Suŋ Ayak

Pen Jiysis Jiwda nan-gep korip ak kirgiy, Saymon korip ak amnak. Saymon biyn numok nuk ak tap yomb giy, mumbwak okok maŋgiysek mon rek yinek mey, biynimb gok apiy Jiysis nup aŋgyak, “Apiy, Saymon numok nup gey, jak amnaŋ aŋgyak.”
Aŋgey, nuk biyn tap gek kum mindek maŋ siŋak apiy aŋgak “Tap gip biy suŋ ayaŋ aŋgak” Kun aŋgakniŋ, won anep suŋ ayek, tikjakiy biynimb ap mindeyak gok kuyip tap keñmaŋgiy gak.
Biynimb kun okok mindeyak gok, minim kun ak niŋiy, pumb paŋind amnak won ak, biynimb kiyk tap gak gok maŋgiysek dand Jiysis mindek ak apeyak, kuyip nokom nokom diniŋakniŋ suŋ ayak.

Pen biynimb malñiluk akaŋ, tap yerip ambaŋ ay mindek gok, aŋgek mis amyiŋg, nup niŋyak rek suk yomb aŋgiy aŋgyak, “Nand Gor Ñinuk.” Kun aŋgey, kuyip kun ma aŋgnimimb aŋgek, aŋgak rek niŋiy mis amniyak.
Jiysis Miñmon Wikan Gunap Amiy Kuyip Minim Aŋgñak
Minek miñmon yowakniŋ, Jiysis miñmon kun ak kirgiy, key minden aŋgiy, miñmon nep namb okok amnak. Amek, biynimb gok kisen amiy, nup piyow niŋiy aŋgyak, “Okok ma amnimin; chin yip mindon aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgey, Jiysis aŋgak, “Gor yip aŋgyokamb opiyn rek, am biynimb wikan gunap kuyip kunep, Gor biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb rek minim ak aŋgniŋgayn aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgiy, okok giraŋgyiŋg, am Jiwda nan-gep korip okok amiy, minim tep kun ak kuyip aŋgñiyiŋgip.
